flawless: Llanowar trains us young. You should have trained longer.
Not a leaf out of place. Go back to the road, wanderer.
solid: You strike hard for an outsider. The forest will remember.
A few scratches, a few lessons, and the win is mine.
close: By oak and root, that was a near thing!
I'll tell the elders I won. I will not be telling them how narrowly.
